title: Surface-water estradiol-benzo[a]pyrene mixtures: Transcriptomics in a PC12 neuronal differentiation model nominate an E2F1-PTPRO axis as a candidate mechanistic biomarker.
authors: Sun, Caiyun; Wang, Peng; Xia, Yu; An, Mengyuan; Liu, Shuang; Wu, Chuanbing; Zhang, Wansheng; Li, Wenwen; Zhou, Yuhan; Hao, Junkai; Xu, Liang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究地表水中雌二醇与苯并芘混合物在PC12神经元分化模型中的转录组学效应，仅用分子对接初步探讨小分子与PTPRO蛋白结合，核心是毒理学表型与通路分析，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Mixtures of estradiol (E2) and benzo[a]pyrene (BaP) occur in surface waters. Seasonal sampling at Longxing Village (Jilin, China) showed total PAHs 1.07-3.14 mg L(-)(1) (BaP 3.0 x10(-)(2)-1.3 x10(-)(1) mg L(-)(1)) and estrogenic compounds 42.4-81.8 ng L(-)(1) .We investigated mechanistic indicators and testable hypotheses capturing their joint neurotoxic effects. METHODS: A PC12 neuronal-differentiation model was exposed to BaP, E2 and NGF. Phenotypic assays (proliferation/viability, ROS, neurite outgrowth) were integrated with time-series transcriptomics (GO/KEGG), qPCR, and molecular docking of E2/BaP to protein tyrosine phosphatase receptor type O (PTPRO). SIGNIFICANT FINDINGS: BaP accelerated proliferation and increased ROS, accompanied by transcriptomic enrichment of chemokine/GPCR-PI3K-Akt survival and anti-apoptotic signaling. Under BaP background, NGF-containing conditions were associated with a shift toward TrkA-MAPK-linked programs and up-regulation of neuronal differentiation/axonogenesis genes, consistent with the observed neurite outgrowth. Docking suggested plausible binding poses of E2 and BaP within a ligandable pocket on PTPRO and associated residue-level interaction features. Consistently, NGF up-regulated PTPRO, BaP attenuated this induction, and E2 + NGF partially restored expression, consistent with an E2F1-PTPRO-linked module. Overall, NGF partially offset BaP-associated toxicity, and PTPRO was nominated as a mechanistic candidate node associated with exposure to axonal growth. Together, these results provide mechanistic plausibility and prioritize E2F1/PTPRO- and ROS-linked pathways as mixture-associated indicators for follow-up validation in water-quality-relevant contexts.
abstract_zh: 背景：地表水中存在雌二醇（E2）与苯并[a]芘（BaP）的混合物。在吉林龙兴村（中国）进行的季节性采样显示，总多环芳烃（PAHs）浓度为1.07-3.14 mg L⁻¹（BaP为3.0×10⁻²-1.3×10⁻¹ mg L⁻¹），雌激素类化合物浓度为42.4-81.8 ng L⁻¹。我们研究了捕捉其联合神经毒性效应的机制性指标和可检验假设。方法：采用PC12神经元分化模型，暴露于BaP、E2和NGF。将表型检测（增殖/活力、ROS、神经突生长）与时间序列转录组学（GO/KEGG）、qPCR以及E2/BaP与蛋白酪氨酸磷酸酶受体O型（PTPRO）的分子对接相结合。主要发现：BaP加速增殖并增加ROS，同时伴随趋化因子/GPCR-PI3K-Akt生存和抗凋亡信号的转录组富集。在BaP背景下，含NGF的条件与向TrkA-MAPK相关程序的转变以及神经元分化/轴突生成基因的上调相关，这与观察到的神经突生长一致。对接结果表明E2和BaP在PTPRO上的可配体口袋内存在合理的结合姿态，并具有相关的残基水平相互作用特征。与此一致，NGF上调PTPRO，BaP减弱了这一诱导效应，而E2+NGF部分恢复了表达，这与E2F1-PTPRO相关模块一致。总体而言，NGF部分抵消了BaP相关毒性，PTPRO被提名为与轴突生长暴露相关的机制性候选节点。综合来看，这些结果提供了机制合理性，并优先将E2F1/PTPRO和ROS相关通路作为混合物相关指标，用于水质相关背景下的后续验证。
